Serving Suggestions
Honey adds moisture to cakes, breads, and
other confections.  It is also an excellent
topping for most baked goods.  One other
common use is as a glaze for meats such
as ham. 
Syrups
Sugar also comes in syrups — thick,
viscous, sweet liquids that have various
tastes and uses.  The most common types
include the following: 
Cane syrup — Thick and extremely
sweet, cane syrup is made from sugar cane.
It is a common ingredient in Caribbean
and Creole recipes.  
Grain  syrups — Sweet syrups can be
made from several grains:  barley, wheat,
corn, or rice.  They are not as sweet as sugar

Chocolate is made from the beans of
the cacao tree, which grows in the warm,
humid weather of the equatorial regions.

tree must be dried, chopped, and roasted
